camel_example: aliyun ros ListResourceTypes --region cn-hangzhou --EntityType Resource --ResourceType 'MODULE::MyOrganization::MyService::MyUsecase' --Provider ROS
description_en: Queries the list of supported resource types
description_zh: 查询支持的资源类型列表
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-resource-types --entity-type Resource --provider ROS --resource-type MODULE::MyOrganization::MyService::MyUsecase --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceTypes

parameters.help_en:
The entity type. Valid values:  

All: all resource types.

Resource (default): regular resource types. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28863.html.

DataSource: data source resource types. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/404753.html.

Module: modules
